measures.label: Behavioral Health Services Act funds allocated to the Behavioral Health Services and Supports component
measures.note: DHCS Behavioral Health Public County Profile Integrated Plan Status file, county Behavioral Health Integrated Plans for the three year period FY 2026-27 to FY 2028-29, values shown for FY 2026-27. FINAL_ADJUSTED_ALLOCATION for the 'Behavioral Health Services and Supports' component: the base allocation after any Housing Intervention exemption adjustment and funding transfer request. Base allocations under the Behavioral Health Services Act are 35 percent Behavioral Health Services and Supports, 35 percent Full Service Partnership and 30 percent Housing Intervention. Sutter County value is the combined Sutter-Yuba behavioral health county plan. DHCS publishes no statewide value in this file.
